baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus repeats the complete qawm-plus-name construction at words 1-2 and 3-4 and coordinates the two constructions with wa-.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinary human-group branch makes each qawm a social body defined relationally by its named prophet. Repeating rather than eliding qawm keeps Abraham's people and Lot's people distinct, parallel, and equally weighted.

activation_trace.role: The human group, following, and kin image grounds both phrases as distinct relational collectives rather than as two bare proper names.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely lists Abraham and Lot.
changed_reading.after: The ayah names two separate social bodies through their relation to Abraham and Lot, preserving parallel cases without collapsing their identities.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both content words in the short focus are repetitions of the q-w-m root in the noun qawm.
baseline_models.mechanism: The bodily-standing and rising-to-an-undertaking branches make a people imaginable as a collective stance: a group becomes visible by what it rises around and undertakes, not only by ancestry or headcount.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing supplies the spatial image of each people as a collective formation that has taken a stance.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking turns social membership into coordinated commitment and action.

changed_reading.before: Qawm is a static demographic label.
changed_reading.after: Each qawm is also a collective posture, constituted by a shared undertaking or refusal around the named prophet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated qawm nouns can activate the root's care, governance, support, and livelihood branches while remaining anchored in the two named communities.
baseline_models.mechanism: A people can function as the human system that tends affairs and supplies the qiwam by which shared life remains standing. The two phrases can therefore denote social orders, not merely populations.

activation_trace.role: Care, preservation, and governance supply the custodial work by which a qawm operates as a social order.
Support, organizing principle, and livelihood supply the load-bearing function of the two communities.

changed_reading.before: The phrases identify groups of persons.
changed_reading.after: The phrases can identify two functioning or failing systems of collective maintenance and authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus consists only of two coordinated nominal phrases and contains no overt event or judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The standing-in-place branch lets each compact qawm-plus-name phrase serve as a representative token for a larger communal episode. Repetition marks two case slots while leaving their actions and outcomes latent.

activation_trace.role: Standing in another's place supplies the metonymic mechanism by which each named people can represent an unstated full episode.

changed_reading.after: Its brevity is functional compression: each people-name stands as a recoverable case file whose event structure is left outside the focus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding double denial supplies the focus's missing predicate, the preceding qawm supplies a serial template, and the following respite and seizure supply the delayed consequence. The two focus phrases become active communal case files in a denial-to-forbearance-to-reckoning sequence.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary people-group image identifies the two collective agents to which the inherited denial applies.
The substitution image lets each short group label stand for a complete historical episode in the serial warning.
Attributing a person or message to falsehood supplies the elided predicate and casts the named peoples as collective deniers.
Noah's people establish the immediately preceding representative-case template that the two focus phrases continue.
Extension of time supplies the interval of respite between communal denial and its consequence.
The split root's explicit granting of delay reinforces that continued standing is temporary permission, not acquittal.
Taking to account for guilt closes the sequence as culpable seizure rather than accidental disappearance.

structural_cues: 22:43 has no finite verb and is coordinated between the active denial in 22:42 and respite plus seizure in 22:44.
The list alternates qawm-plus-prophet, bare people names, companions of a place, and a singular prophet in passive syntax, so each label compresses a distinct relation to denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial before the focus and respite followed by seizure after it; I carry that predicate and temporal arrow across the coordinated fragment. A live alternative is that only the denial predicate is syntactically inherited while the later first-person sequence summarizes the list more generally.

changed_reading.before: Two peoples are inserted as bare historical names.
changed_reading.after: Both peoples are collective deniers held through a real interval of respite and then taken to account, with each short phrase carrying a full causal history.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the warning list, empowerment is tested by what a plural community establishes, gives, commands, and restrains. This activates qawm as collective capacity under an ethical test: the focus peoples are not neutral demographics but social powers whose stance toward prophetic correction reveals whether their order upholds or corrupts.

activation_trace.role: Care, governance, and sustained oversight make each qawm legible as an accountable custodial order.
The support and organizing-principle image frames a people as the structure that keeps communal life operative.
Empowerment and capacity supply the condition under which a collective's governing commitments become visible.
Establishing and maintaining prayer gives the q-w-m root an enacted custodial benchmark immediately before the named peoples.

structural_cues: 22:41's empowered plural subjects immediately precede the denial catalogue beginning in 22:42.
The ethical actions in 22:41 are institutional and repeated, matching a collective rather than a momentary individual posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional empowerment and a list of maintained public practices; I infer that adjacency makes these practices a diagnostic for the social standing encoded by qawm. The warning catalogue can alternatively be read as an independent set of precedents with no governance contrast.

changed_reading.before: The named peoples are populations that happened to reject messengers.
changed_reading.after: They are accountable collective capacities: their denial is a failure of the social order they were able to stand up and maintain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier Abraham scene joins an assigned dwelling-place, the House, and standing worshippers. When the focus later says Abraham's qawm, the shared name and q-w-m root create an irony: affiliation with Abraham is measured against a place-making and worship-maintaining vocation that his historical people did not embody.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing lets Abraham's qawm resonate against the earlier standing worshippers.
Maintenance and care turn standing near Abraham into a vocation rather than a mere label of association.
Taking or assigning a settled place supplies Abraham's constructive place-making role.
The shelter and dwelling image gives Abraham's vocation a shared spatial center.
The literal standing worshippers activate qawm as a communal posture around Abraham's House.

structural_cues: The proper name Abraham occurs in both 22:26 and the focus, connecting the scenes without requiring a root citation for the name.
In 22:26 standing is coordinated with circling, bowing, and prostrating, so it belongs to an enacted communal order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Abraham, the House, and standing worshippers; I infer that the repeated name and root make this scene a standard against which 'Abraham's people' is heard. The alternative is simple recurrence of a proper name with no ironic cross-reference.

changed_reading.before: Abraham's people is only a historical possessive label.
changed_reading.after: The label becomes ironic and evaluative: proximity to Abraham is tested by whether a people stands within his place-making, purifying, worship-maintaining vocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated every-community-and-rite formula before and after the focus distinguishes a mere social group from a community organized by a practiced way. This does not equate qawm with ummah; it makes the focus peoples readable as collectives whose identity is enacted and contested through recurring practice.

activation_trace.role: Sustained care and governance supply the focus-side mechanism by which shared practice can maintain a people.
The community or kind image supplies an explicit neighboring category of collective identity.
The community-as-way image makes collective identity directional and practiced rather than merely genealogical.
A locus and act of ritual supplies the concrete practice around which a community is organized.
The later repetition of community as a way keeps the practice-shaped lens active beyond the historical list.
Persevering on a path turns the repeated rite into durable communal formation.

structural_cues: Closely matched every-ummah-and-mansak formulas occur at 22:34 and 22:67, on opposite sides of the focus.
The focus itself repeats relational group labels, leaving the basis of their cohesion available for contextual specification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two repeated ummah-mansak formulas; I use them as a lens on how a qawm is maintained while preserving the lexical distinction between qawm and ummah. A live alternative is that the formulas concern legal plurality only and do not redescribe the focus peoples.

changed_reading.before: Each qawm is a kin or follower group fixed by a prophet's name.
changed_reading.after: Each can also be heard as a community continually formed by a way of acting, so belonging and denial are enacted rather than guaranteed by the name.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby social ecology makes groups forces that check other groups and thereby preserve vulnerable institutions. This activates qawm's resistance and support branches: the focus peoples are formations capable of protecting a moral-spatial order or organizing themselves against it.

activation_trace.role: Resistance and contest supply the image of each people as an organized force standing against another party.
Support and social qiwam supply the positive capacity that collective force could preserve.
Pushing away harm supplies the reciprocal social-check mechanism through which groups protect shared space.
Casting down a building names the institutional loss that unchecked collective force would produce.
Aid that makes another prevail supplies the supportive alternative to communal resistance against a messenger.

structural_cues: 22:40 explicitly distributes action among people, some by means of others, before 22:42-44 names historical collectives.
The protected sites are plural and socially maintained, so counterforce has institutional consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal pushing, threatened buildings, and aid; I infer that qawm names the sort of organized social force that can occupy either side of this mechanism. The alternative is that 22:40 concerns only divine protection and the later qawm labels carry no counterforce resonance.

changed_reading.before: The peoples are passive containers of many individuals.
changed_reading.after: They are organized counterforces whose collective standing can preserve shared institutions or harden into coordinated opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate aftermath translates lost peoplehood into a settlement's failed operations: a gathered village becomes empty or fallen, its roof-support loses qiwam, and its well is disabled. The qawm is thus the human maintenance system whose removal leaves resources and monuments without use.

activation_trace.role: Care and preservation supply the recurring human work absent from the ruined settlement.
Qiwam as support, order, and livelihood makes a people the load-bearing system of civic life.
A standing tool or structural part supplies a material analogy for the community's supporting function.
People gathered into a village converts the focus's social groups into inhabited civic formations.
Emptiness supplies the demographic and functional absence left when the communal operator is gone.
The branch's qiwam of an affair, stable or toppled, makes the roofs a material analogue for collective support.
Vacancy and disabling show that an existing resource can survive materially while losing its social use.

structural_cues: 22:45 follows the focus catalogue's respite-and-seizure conclusion without a new addressee.
The ruin image combines habitation, roof structure, water infrastructure, and monumental building, moving from persons to a whole civic system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered settlement, emptiness, structural collapse, and disabled infrastructure; I infer that qawm is the human qiwam connecting these operations. The alternative is that the material ruins are only evidence of punishment, not an exposition of what a people functionally is.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns populations removed by punishment.
changed_reading.after: It also concerns the loss of civic maintenance: when a qawm's ethical qiwam fails and the people are removed, wells, roofs, and palaces cease to form a living settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing address reopens the genitive relation in Abraham's qawm by calling Abraham father within a followed way and then commanding maintained practice. The same person can name a denying historical people and a later community of affiliation, so being 'of Abraham' is neither exclusive possession nor automatic fidelity.

activation_trace.role: The group, following, and kin image keeps the focus anchored in a contested social relation to Abraham.
Standing in another's place allows one Abraham-associated collective to be contrasted with another without treating either label as exhaustive.
A followed religious way supplies a practice-based mode of affiliation with Abraham.
A path made recognizable by repeated travel turns inherited affiliation into a way that must actually be walked.
Fatherhood and nurture extend Abrahamic relation beyond the earlier historical qawm while retaining relational identity.
The command to establish and maintain prayer makes ongoing practice the closing test of the claimed relation.

structural_cues: The proper name Abraham recurs in 22:78 as 'your father' after appearing in the focus as the possessor of a historical qawm.
The final address combines naming, witness, maintained prayer, almsgiving, and holding fast, giving affiliation a public enacted form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two different possessive relations to Abraham and a closing sequence of communal practices; I infer that the latter contests any claim that the earlier qawm exhausts Abrahamic belonging. The alternative is that one phrase is purely historical and the other purely genealogical, with no deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: Abraham's qawm is the fixed group naturally belonging to him.
changed_reading.after: The phrase exposes contested succession: a people may bear Abraham's relation while denying him, whereas another collective enters his followed way through enacted fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Occurrences of qiyamah on both sides of the focus activate the same root's final-standing branch. The named historical qawm are temporary collective standings whose unresolved truth-status is carried toward the standing of judgment rather than sealed in the past.

activation_trace.role: The resurrection and final-standing image places differentiated religious collectivities before a future adjudication.
Ordinary standing supplies the bridge from presently constituted peoples to their eventual standing for judgment.
The focus root's resurrection branch keeps the historical groups eschatologically live rather than merely archival.
The later day of standing explicitly returns disputes among communities to final judgment.

structural_cues: Qiyamah occurrences precede and follow the focus within the same surah, using the same q-w-m root as qawm.
22:17 and 22:69 both place differentiated human groups or disputes within final judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated q-w-m forms for peoples and the final standing; I infer a temporal resonance from provisional social standing to eschatological standing. The live alternative is strict lexical separation between qawm and qiyamah with no intended activation.

changed_reading.before: The two peoples are closed cases in remote history.
changed_reading.after: They are provisional collective standings whose dispute with truth remains legible within the surah's horizon of final standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the standing-eye branch is far from the ordinary noun qawm. It remains anchored in the focus's q-w-m root and is unusually activated by 22:46's explicit contrast between intact eyes and blinded hearts; downstream prose should present it only as a diagnostic analogy, never as a lexical translation of qawm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both qawm tokens carry q-w-m, whose inventory includes an intact standing eye that has lost sight.

activation_trace.role: The intact but sightless standing eye supplies the image of a collective whose outer organization remains while perception has failed.
Blindness of heart and insight explicitly relocates perceptual failure from the organ to the community's interior judgment.
Physical eyesight supplies the intact exterior capacity that the ayah distinguishes from failed inner seeing.
The heart as inward faculty supplies the hidden site where an apparently standing people can become blind.

changed_reading.before: The peoples are visibly coherent groups that make a bad decision.
changed_reading.after: They may be imagined as socially intact-looking bodies whose inner faculty of recognition has already gone dark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because qawm is commonly rendered as an unmarked inclusive people. It remains valid because the packet's B001 scope preserves an originally male-coded collective with women included by extension, while 22:2 makes nursing and pregnancy explicit within al-nas; downstream prose should flag lexical compression without claiming that the focus excludes women.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated qawm uses the branch whose scope includes both a human collective and an originally male public grouping.

activation_trace.role: The people-and-men branch exposes how the compact collective label can foreground male social actors while extending to a whole population.
Literal breastfeeding makes maternal embodied experience explicit rather than leaving it submerged in a generic collective.
Internal pregnancy and fruit-bearing supply a second explicitly female-coded life relation within the surah's universal human scene.
The manifest human collective supplies the inclusive frame within which the focus's narrower social label must be handled carefully.

changed_reading.before: Each qawm transparently names every member in the same way.
changed_reading.after: Each phrase may compress an entire population under a male-coded public collective term, so the named history includes lives not equally visible in the label.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation from ritual bodies to political bodies, so it is too distant to assert as the focus's meaning. It remains anchored by q-w-m's literal standing branch and the nearby packet sequence of aligned bodies followed by falling; downstream prose should mark it as an embodied analogy for contingent collective stability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two qawm nouns can activate bodily standing while naming whole social bodies.

activation_trace.role: Bodily uprightness supplies the initial posture for imagining each people as a standing social body.
Alignment on a level row supplies visible collective order and apparent stability.
Falling after alignment supplies the reversal from an upright formation to a body brought down.

changed_reading.before: The two communities are stable names in a list.
changed_reading.after: Each can be carried as a once-upright social body whose ordered stance was real but contingent and capable of sudden fall.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fly parable is remote from the historical list and does not define qawm. It remains anchored through qawm's group and qiwam branches and the packet's explicit assembly-then-weakness mechanism; downstream prose should use it only to distinguish numerical aggregation from effective collective standing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qawm names a gathered people but also activates the root's support and sustaining-capacity branch.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary group image supplies aggregation as the minimal social fact of each named people.
Qiwam as sustaining capacity asks whether aggregation actually supports effective communal action.
Gathering dispersed units into one supplies assembly without yet guaranteeing capability.
Collected strength supplies the capacity that the parable tests and finds absent.
Weakness opposed to strength reveals that many gathered actors can still lack operative qiwam.

changed_reading.before: Being a qawm itself implies consequential collective power.
changed_reading.after: The label can expose a gap between being assembled and possessing the sustaining capacity to act rightly or effectively.

strongest_changes: The verbless focus becomes two full communal case files inside an inherited denial, respite, and seizure sequence.
Qawm shifts from demographic label to accountable collective standing: an empowered social order is judged by what it establishes and maintains.
The ruined village, fallen support, and disabled well materialize the missing civic qiwam once the people are gone.
The closing way of father Abraham prevents 'Abraham's people' from functioning as an uncontested or automatically faithful affiliation.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated q-w-m root sustained several coexisting mechanisms without forcing a final choice: human group, collective stance, custodial order, resistance, representative case, and final standing. The most unusual but still anchored activations treated a people as an intact-looking blind body, a gender-compressing public label, a standing body liable to fall, and an assembly that may lack qiwam.
remaining_uncertainties: How strongly qawm's non-social branches should sound in ordinary reading remains uncertain; several are diagnostic resonances rather than lexical senses.
The Abraham-House and closing Abrahamic-way links may be deliberate intra-surah contrasts or context-enabled associations whose force should remain qualified.
The civic, bodily, gendered, and assembly analogies should coexist as lenses; none by itself exhausts the two historical peoples.
